summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Dezi Market API. All 38 pytest tests passed (100%) covering auth (admin/moderator/user JWT+cookie), designs CRUD with role-based status assignment, filters (q/category/style/price/sort), view count increment, moderation (approve/reject), likes/favorites toggle, mocked purchase + paid download gating (402), free download, comments CRUD, admin user management, role-based access control, and Local Storage / MongoDB upload + serve (image type validation).

minor.issue: Endpoint not declared as require_auth but relies on refresh cookie; if cookie is missing returns 401 — works as designed, no client-side helper documented.
When status query parameter is anything besides 'approved' and caller is unauthenticated/non-staff, server silently coerces to 'approved' (no 403). Acceptable behavior but worth documenting.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 840 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth.py, designs.py, admin.py, files.py, models.py) for maintainability per >700 line rule.

CORSMiddleware uses allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combo. Use allow_origin_regex='.*' (already present) OR explicit origin list. Currently works because Starlette echoes origin when regex matches, but allow_origins='*' is misleading and should be removed.
JWT cookies use secure=False — fine for preview but must be True in production behind HTTPS.
No rate-limiting/brute-force protection on /api/auth/login (playbook recommends lockout after 5 fails).
serialize_design issues an extra Mongo query per design for author + favorites + likes — N+1 pattern; for large lists use aggregation/$lookup.
DesignCreate.images accepts arbitrary strings without verifying they exist in db.files; could store dangling references.
/api/files/{path} streams entire object into memory before responding — fine for <10MB but no streaming chunking from storage.
test_credentials: admin@dezi.ru / admin12345, moderator@dezi.ru / moder12345 — both confirmed working; bcrypt hash $2b$ format used; cookies httpOnly set on login.
seed_data_creation: Tests register ephemeral TEST_ prefixed user accounts and create TEST_ prefixed designs. Created designs are deleted in TestCleanup. Registered user accounts remain in DB (no admin endpoint to delete users).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully functional. All endpoints from the review request work as specified, including role-based access (user→pending, admin/mod→approved), 402 paid-gating, mocked purchase, view increment, like/favorite toggles, comments CRUD, Local Storage / MongoDB upload/serve, admin user role management. Use /app/backend/tests/test_dezi_backend.py for regression. Pytest fixtures use module-level pytest attrs to share design IDs between tests — keep ordering if expanding.
